findings.the answer: YES — 3 of 11 catalogue rows place 34 times at one level and 2 of those survive every clause (Q5, Q7), the shortest being Q7 at 5.331 nm; and EVERY ONE OF THEM LIES IN THE PLAN
findings.the clause funnel: 11 catalogue rows -> 3 place 34 at one level -> 2 survive every clause. The row lost between the last two is the single strand, which is compact (6.04 nm) and ONE-SIDED
findings.what refuses the flexure: NOT the plan and NOT C-0063's placement, but its END CONDITION. A midspan-loaded beam's c is 48-192 and an end-loaded one's is at most 12, and the span is c^(1/3) — so the same duplex at the same rigidity and the same stiffness is 1.59x longer for being supported twice. The plan budget is 8.19 nm and the midspan family's floor is 22.41 nm
findings.the out-of-plane escape: does not exist. A member standing along z and loaded along z is loaded AXIALLY (S/k = 1122 nm), a fold spends along-row slack to buy across-row room that the lattice does not have, and a second LEVEL is reached only by a vertical member, whose clash is level-independent (C-0041). The escape that works is not out of the plan, it is SHORT in it
findings.the margin: the element that places does so by 0.0256 nm — 0.075 of a base-pair rise — and at the 2.73 nm square-lattice interhelical distance it does not place at all
findings.the shorter element and what it costs: Q7, the standoff-headed crank, is 1.532x shorter than the hinge-rooted arm and clears the plan budget by 2.86 nm rather than 0.026 — but it stands on an UNDEMONSTRATED normal duplex (C-0028/C-0029), its standoff carries 2.941 pN in compression against a 7.21 pN free-head Euler load (2.45x, CH-0037's reading), and its assembled tangent minimum over [0, 3] clears only 4 of C-0017's six 2 mM stability floors against the arm's 6
findings.the recommendation: the truss branch's output stage is the HINGE-ROOTED ARM, not a flexure the truss caps — and the truss is the wrong root for it, because a rigid root demands a LONGER arm (c = 3 exactly, 9.247 nm) than a single crossover does
findings.maturity: TRL 1-3. Nothing here is measured; the motif — a free lever held to a single-layer sheet by one crossover — is this programme's own construct (C-0055, 62 recorded queries) and is undemonstrated
